Goods delivered on the 2nd, tax invoice on the 20th. On time?

No. Under Federal Decree-Law No. 8 of 2017 on VAT, Art. 67(1), a registrant generally issues a tax invoice within 14 days of the date of supply (elaws.moj.gov.ae, checked 12 Nov 2026); here it is 18 days (illustrative).
